tei:div.tei:p: 367) ༄༅/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bshad pa mdor bsdus nye bar mkho ba dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar bzhugs so/ 378) lags 'o na da lam gyi skabs 'di nyid du zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bgyis pa ni bsod nams dag ngo mtshar gyi mchog tu gyur pa lags shing*/ de la tshogs kyi ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba ji ltar bgyi ba'i thabs/ bgyis pa'i phan yon dang bcas pa'i rim pa las dang po ngo bo ni/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ lha dang bla ma mched lcam rnams kyi dgyes pa skong bar byed pa'i rdzas kyi rnam grangs so/ nges tshig ni/ legs sbyar gyi skad du ga ṇa zhes bya ba de nyid 369) bod skad du tshogs ces bya ste/ thabs shes kyi rdzas su gyur pa'i 'dod yon bza' btung gi rnam grangs mang po tshogs par bshams pas na tshogs ces bya'o/ dbye ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid las/ phyi ltar na dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i tshogs snod du gling bzhi ri rab rol mtsho dang bcas pa tshogs kyi yo byad du rang bzhin gyis bkod cing*/ bcud kyi sems can skye 'gro mtha' dag tshogs kyi rgyan du ye nas lhun gyis grub pa ni snang srid rang byung phyi'i tshogs mchod rmad du byung ba de nyid bla ma yi 370) dam mkha' 'gro tshogs la rang byung rang babs chen por 'bul ba ni phyi'i tshogs/ nag ltar na/ thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba'i rigs gyur thams cad dang*/ shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba'i rigs gyur thams cad dang*/ gnyis med kyi rdzas bca' ba'i rigs gyur la sogs pa mdor na 'dod yon gyi longs spyod ci 'byor thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyisabarlabs te 'bul ba ni gsang ba'i tshogs/ de kho na nyid du/ rang rigs spros bral rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba kun khyab yangs pa chen po'i tshogs snod du sems yid rnam shes dbang tshogs kyi 'du shes 'gyu dran phra rag bzang ngan gyi rtog tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rol rtsal

371) mtha' dag rang rig rang shes rang grol gyi tshogs su byin gyis brlabs nas/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi ngang du 'bul bya 'bul byed dang bral ba nyid du yin lugs rang ngo shes pa ni de kho na nyid yang dag don gyi tshogs mchod do/ mdor na snang srid phyi nang snod bcud thams cad tshogs kyi rang bzhin du ma gyur pa med pa'i don tshul bzhin du shes dgos shing*/ de lta bu'i dbye ba rtogs pas/ nang gi tshogs mchod dngos gzhi ji ltar bgyi ba'i thabs sam tshul ni/ spyir gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs 'dod yon thams cad tshogs kyi dngos por ma gyur ba med cing*/ bye brag tu bza' ba thabs kyi rang bzhin dang*/ btung ba shes rab kyi rang bzhin la sogs tshogs rdzas kyi dngos por gyur tshad ji ltar 'byor ba legs par bshams shing*/ ye shes rnam rol gyi 372) me ram̐ chu kham̐ rlung yam̐ gsum 'phros pas kun rdzob 'khrul snang nyes tshogs kyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ ༈ sku gsum ye shes kyi rtsal snang 'bru om̐ ā hūm̐/ gsum gyi 'od zer 'phro

sa pas bde chen zag med kyi bdud rtsir yid bzhin 'dod 'byung gi gter du byin gyis brlabs/ de nyid yul gong ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa'i dngos por phul/ chos skyong srung ma rnams la ci 'dod kyi bskang rdzas phul/ mched dang lcam dral thams cad dngos grub dam rdzas kyi tshul du rol/ zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bka'i pham phab kyi tshil du gtong ba la sogs yul gong 'og kun la so sor gang la 'tsham par mchod sbyin bya zhing*/ de dag gi tshe yang rlom sems khe grags lo 'dod ser sna re dogs la sogs pa'i bsam pa dang ma 'dres par ting 'dzin ye shes rnam rol gyi ngang nas dag snang mos gus snying rje ldan zhing lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas 'bul/ tshogs kyi yo byad kyang*/ 'byor pa'i tshe na 'dod yon gyi longs spyod gyur to cog thams cad 'phang sems zhen chags bral bas ci yod tshogs su bshams/ ma 'byor ba'i tshe na chi la'ang rung zhing*/ lhag bsam gyi kun nas blangs shing ting 'dzin gyi kha bsgyur shes na dngos po thams cad tshogs mchod du ma gyur pa rdul tsam yang med pas cir snang chos nyid rnam rol chen po'i ngang du spyad/ rang nyid bza' btung ti rigs gang la spyod tshe'ang*/ dngos grub tshogs kyi 'khor lor dmigs te phung khams skye mched thams cad rgyal ba'i ladakyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub cing*/ gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung bkod pa byang chub sems kyi snang lugs gnas tshul thams cad ni gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing la sogs par ye nas rang byung du mchis shing*/ phyi 374) rol gyi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi mtha' dag nang du rdo rje'i lus kyi spyo bo la sogs pa'i gnas dang*/ yul de dag gi dpa' bo rdo rje 'od ldan yab yum la sogs rnams kyang nang du rtsa sgom pa la sogs pa'i rtsa rlung thig le'i tshul du lhun grub tu bzhugs par rgyud sde mtha' dag las gsungs phyir/

nang du ting 'dzin rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshogs kyi mchod pa lan gcig byas na phyi rol yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba kun la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dus gcig tu bgyis pa'i bsod nams thob cing*/ der yang ma zad theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po ltar na tsat+ta 'od khyim gyi klong na sangs rgyas zhi ba sum cu rtsa drug klad pa dung khang gi nang du khro bo khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ mgrin pa rtsa'i dra ba na rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha 575) tshogs/ gnas drug rtsa'i 'khor lo ru bcom ldan thub pa rigs drug la sogs zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad lus gnas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kho na yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang ba spu'i bu ga re re na yang mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i pho brang yin par gsungs pas na de phyir bza' btung 'khor gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ba'i gnad rnams shes par bya/ mdor bsdu na/ bshams pa rdzas kyi tshogs 'khor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mched lcam dang bcas pa rnams la spyir 'bul/ sgyu lus phung po'i tshogs 'khor ting 'dzin gnad dang ldan pas snang srid lha 'dre la sogs mchod sbyin gyi du gyur po gong 'og bar ma rnams la bye brag tu 'bul/ bza' btung rgyun gyi tshogs 'khor log 'tsho dkor sdig dang ma 'dres pa phung khams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la khyad par du 'bul/ cir snang chos nyid kyi tshogs 'khor rang 376)shar rang grol gyi ngang nas yengs 'khrul gnyis 'dzin dang bral zhing dgag bsgrub blang dor las 'das pa rang rig ka dag gi ngang du don dam par 'bul ba ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dag pa'o/ de lta bu'i tshogs kyi mchod pa bgyis pa dgos ched dang phan yon ji lta bu yod zhe na/ theg pa'i mthar thug rdzogs pa rang byung gi rgyud las/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yon tan ni/ tshe rabs snga phyi dpag med sgrib pa rnams// zhi khro'i spyan sngar skad cig tsam gyis byang*// tshe rabs phyi ma gnas ni gar skyes kyang*// yo byad chung ba dag tu mi 'gyur zhing*/

rtag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur bar 'gyur// rin chen nor dang 'bru la longs spyod cing*// rdzas dang yo byad ldan pa'i skyes bur 'gyur// ces gnas skabs kyi yon tan dang*/ de bas lhag pa'i yon tan 'di rnams thob// bar do rang snang ye shes dag mthong bas// de la grol nas mi 'gyur sa la gnas// sprul ba stong gsum gang bas 'gro don byed// de lta bu yon tan thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing mdor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i phan yon ni dpag tu med do/ ༈ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las 'grub/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad gsor chud/ lha dang bla ma dam can mched lcam gyi dgyes pa skongs/ mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bsal/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub cig char du thob pa la sogs pa'i phan yon gyi rnam grangs brjod las 'das pa thob cing*/ gsang sngags bla med rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par gyi zab gnad cha rkyen kha skongs lag len rmad byung du byung ba yin yang rgyun ldan du brtson par mdzad 'tshal/ tshogs kyi rnam bshad mdor 378) bsdus 'di/ rab mdzes ku ra'i gos 'chang ba'i/ rig sngags 'dzin pa (dkar po ba kun dga' bstan 'dzin )des bskul ngor// bkod 'dis 'gro la phan 'grub shog /de las cher spros pa'i tshogs kyi 'du ba bsgrags pa dang tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba ji lta ba rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i tshul dag spro bar nus mod kyang*/ de+ing sang bskal ba snyigs ma'i mtha' la ches cher thug pa'i rang tshul 'dis/ de lta bu'i nus ldan gyi gtso cher tshul ldan dgon che 'dir bshad kyang ngal ba don med las mi 'gyur bas re zhig 'di tsam gyis chog par sems so//
